description: Get the active relay network policy (GET /v1/policy, public): which destination ports nodes will dial (only 80/443, ever), plaintext HTTP mode (deny | opt_in via allowhttp-1 | allow), requester rate/spend limits, sanctioned countries, node defaults, the attestation text node operators sign, and the fixed node-floor guarantees (no private/loopback/metadata targets, no SMTP/SSH/RDP). Read this before fetching or registering a node.
name: dominusnode_network_policy
